patterns: Every language module exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as &str constants
LanguageInfo struct wired in get_language_info() match arm with tree-sitter language binding and handler function pointers

Inheritance extraction walks node tree for parent/base/interface nodes and extracts names using child_by_field_name() or named_child()
DEFUSE_QUERY uses capture groups like @write.local, @write.assign, @read.usage to mark definition/use sites
Query compilation tested in module-level #[test] functions; tree_sitter::Query::new(&lang, QUERY_STR).expect()

library_findings.relevant_api: class_declaration (name, body, base_clause, class_interface_clause), interface_declaration (name, body, class_interface_clause), trait_declaration (name, body), enum_declaration (name, body, class_interface_clause), method_declaration (name, formal_parameters, compound_statement), function_definition (name, formal_parameters, compound_statement)
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as child nodes, not fields on class_declaration. Inheritance walk must traverse children to find these nodes. Methods are method_declaration; top-level functions are function_definition. Supports PHP 8.3 features including enums, attributes, match expressions.

library_findings.relevant_api: Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::named_child(), Node::child_count(), Node::kind(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte(), Query::new(), QueryCursor::matches(), QueryMatch::captures()
library_findings.notes: Bounds check required: end_byte() may exceed source.len() for incomplete parses. Field names are grammar-specific; PHP uses 'name' for identifiers, 'body' for declaration lists.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Full OOP Integration (Recommended)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php as workspace dependency. Create crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration, method_declaration, and function_definition. Implement extract_inheritance() to walk base_clause and class_interface_clause children. Implement DEFUSE_QUERY for local variable declarations and identifier reads. Wire in mod.rs get_language_info() match arm and lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP (.php -> php). Add integration tests.
pros: Comprehensive support for PHP 8.3 OOP features (classes, interfaces, traits, enums)
Inheritance extraction for extends and implements relationships
Def-use site detection for local scopes
Enables full symbol table extraction for PHP codebases
cons: Inheritance walk must handle base_clause and class_interface_clause as children, not fields
PHP's mixed static/dynamic nature limits some handler capabilities (e.g., find_receiver_type may be less reliable)

approaches.name: Approach 2: Minimal Structural Support
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php dependency. Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY only (classes, interfaces, traits, enums, methods, functions) and CALL_QUERY. Skip DEFUSE_QUERY, reference_query, and inheritance extraction handlers. Wire in mod.rs and lang.rs. Minimal test coverage.
pros: Covers primary use case: symbol table extraction
cons: No def-use site detection (breaks semantic analysis for PHP)
May require rework to add DEFUSE_QUERY later

approaches.name: Approach 3: Phased Integration with Stub DEFUSE_QUERY
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php dependency. Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, and a minimal DEFUSE_QUERY (identifier reads only, no write sites). Implement extract_inheritance() for base_clause/class_interface_clause. Skip find_method_for_receiver and find_receiver_type. Wire in mod.rs and lang.rs. Plan follow-up issue for full DEFUSE_QUERY.
pros: Clear path to full support in follow-up work
cons: Missing receiver type handlers (method resolution limited)

recommendation: Approach 1 (Full OOP Integration). PHP is a mature OOP language with 8.3 features (enums, attributes, match expressions); users expect full symbol table extraction and inheritance information. The Swift integration (October 2026) demonstrates the codebase is ready for comprehensive language support. DEFUSE_QUERY is architecturally required and not optional. Inheritance extraction is essential for refactoring tools. The base_clause/class_interface_clause child-node pattern is well-documented in Context7 and straightforward to implement. Full support aligns with project goals (59% token savings via precise symbol tables) and user expectations for a mature language.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
pub const ELEMENT_QUERY: &str = r"
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(function_definition
  name: (name) @function_name) @function
";
inheritance_walk_citation: PHP class_declaration node has no 'superclass' or 'interfaces' fields. Instead, walk the class_declaration's children: (1) find base_clause child node (if present), extract its first named_child (a name node) as the extends parent; (2) find class_interface_clause child node (if present), iterate its named_children, each is a name node representing an implements interface. Source: tree-sitter-php grammar rule class_declaration in common/define-grammar.js uses optional($.base_clause) and optional($.class_interface_clause) as child sequences, not fields. Confirmed in node-types.json: class_declaration fields are only attributes, body, name.
